title: 006 人类的唯一生机-《第19次末日》
content:
第(1/3)页

    林少凡脚步声渐近。

    晏梨切断了思绪，她环顾了一下四周，视线落在了公告栏旁边的老式配电箱上。

    她抬起手来，瞄准了配电箱的位置，抬手就是一枪。

    只听得嘭的一声响，紧接着配电箱冒出了巨大的火花，楼道里的灯光不停地闪动，像是恐怖片里恶鬼即将降临一般。

    那灯闪了一会儿，终于灭了，四周一片黑暗，伸手不见五指。

    墙上天花板上的眼睛与人影，彻底消失不见。

    青年路218号仿佛当真变成了晏梨年幼之时曾经住过的家，空气中都能闻到一股淡淡的化学药剂的味道。

    那是父亲晏淮山研究单位的家属楼，住在一楼的谢爷爷是个怪老头。

    他家中三日要起一次小火，五日要发生一次小爆炸。

    谢奶奶是个消防员，身强力壮，起火和爆炸之后，整个楼里都是谢老头被揍的哭爹喊娘声。

    那时候她就站在小女孩跳绳的位置，兴奋地看热闹，在虚空中左钩右拳，一通哼哈。

    再后来，他们都死了。

    她也夭折了，成为了户籍系统里不存在的人。

    谢爷爷的孙子来假坟头祭拜她，带来了谢爷爷留给她的礼物。

    她后来出任务的时候听说了，那礼物将她的坟头炸出了一个洞，骨灰乱扬。

    她几乎不会想起从前，毕竟她没有过去，也没有未来。

    “妈妈，我要妈妈！”

    广告栏下的红衣小女孩扔掉了手中的跳绳，她背靠着单元门哇哇大哭。

    爆炸的火光照亮了她满是泪痕的脸，晏梨这一次清楚的看见了她的长相，这是年幼时候的她。

    晏梨抿了抿嘴唇，感受着身后的劲风，她猛的一个翻滚，光脚站在了一楼的地面上。

    手中的长刀直接架住了林少凡从身后劈来的警棍。

    配电箱爆炸之后，楼里断了电，她光脚站在地上，也不用担心会被那些赛博鬼怪抓住上身了。

    “看来你有独立的备用电源。”

    晏梨看着林少凡，饶有兴致地说道。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Lin Shaofan’s footsteps approached.

Yan Li cut off her thoughts. She looked around and her eyes fell on the old-fashioned distribution box next to the bulletin board.

She raised her hand, aimed at the distribution box, and fired a shot.

There was only a bang, followed by huge sparks from the distribution box, and the lights in the corridor kept flashing, like an evil spirit in a horror movie about to come.

The light flashed for a while and finally went out. It was dark all around and you couldn't see your fingers.

The eyes and figures on the wall and ceiling completely disappeared.

No. 218 Qingnian Road seems to have become the home where Yan Li once lived when she was young. A faint smell of chemicals can be smelled in the air.

That is the family building of my father Yan Huaishan’s research unit. Grandpa Xie who lives on the first floor is a strange old man.

There will be a small fire in his house every three days and a small explosion on the fifth day.

Grandma Xie is a firefighter and is very strong. After the fire and explosion, the whole building was filled with the sound of old man Xie crying for his father and mother after being beaten.

At that time, she was standing where the little girl was skipping, watching the excitement excitedly, hooking left and right fists in the air, humming.

Later, they all died.

She also died young and became a person who did not exist in the household registration system.

Grandpa Xie’s grandson came to worship her at the fake grave and brought the gift that Grandpa Xie left for her.

She later heard about it when she was on a mission. The gift blew a hole in her grave and scattered her ashes.

She will hardly remember the past. After all, she has no past and no future.

"Mom, I want mom!"

The little girl in red under the advertisement column threw away the skipping rope in her hand. She leaned against the unit door and cried loudly.

The fire from the explosion illuminated her tear-stained face, and Yan Li could clearly see her appearance this time. This was her when she was young.

Yan Li pursed her lips, feeling the strong wind behind her. She rolled violently and stood barefoot on the ground on the first floor.

The long knife in his hand directly blocked the baton that Lin Shaofan struck from behind.

After the distribution box exploded, the power in the building was cut off. She stood barefoot on the ground without having to worry about being caught by those cyber ghosts.

"It looks like you have an independent backup power source."

Yan Li looked at Lin Shaofan and said with interest.
